name: BottomSheet
description: A mobile-style modal sheet that springs up from the bottom edge with a drag handle and snap points. Drag (with velocity projection) to resize between snaps or flick down to dismiss; the handle is also a keyboard-operable button.
a11yNotes: role="dialog" with aria-modal, aria-labelledby (title) and aria-describedby (description); the trigger exposes aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded. The drag handle is a real button labelled "Expand sheet" / "Collapse sheet": Enter/Space toggles between the lowest and highest snap, ArrowUp/ArrowDown step between snaps (ArrowDown at the lowest snap closes when dismissible), Home/End jump to the extremes. Focus is trapped inside while open, Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger and body scroll is locked. Under prefers-reduced-motion the sheet snaps without springing.

defaultProps.title: Share project
defaultProps.description: Anyone with the link can view. Drag the handle or use the arrow keys to resize.

propsApi.name: onOpenChange
propsApi.description: Called whenever the sheet requests to open or close.

propsApi.name: snapPoints
propsApi.description: Snap heights as fractions of the viewport height (clamped to 0.1 to 1, sorted ascending).

propsApi.name: defaultSnap
propsApi.description: Index of the snap point the sheet opens at.

propsApi.name: onSnapChange
propsApi.description: Called when the sheet moves to a different snap index.

propsApi.name: title
propsApi.description: Sheet title, used as the accessible name.

propsApi.name: description

propsApi.description: Supporting text under the title, used as the accessible description.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Sheet content; defaults to share actions and a people list.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Accent for the focused handle, action hovers and avatars.

propsApi.name: backdropBlur
propsApi.description: Backdrop blur radius in pixels; the backdrop fades with the drag position.

propsApi.name: dismissible
propsApi.description: Allow closing by flicking/dragging below the lowest snap or clicking the backdrop.

propsApi.name: maxWidth
propsApi.description: Maximum sheet width in pixels; centered on wide screens.

propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
